doc: Sibling of func_8004E5A0 (which wraps func_8004E57C, the space-padded formatter). This one calls func_8004E4C0 directly with the pad char hardcoded to '0' (0x30), then reverses the digits via func_8004E478, and returns the buffer pointer. Both callees remain nonmatching in src/code.c but their signatures were inferred from the already-matched wrapper func_8004E57C and this function's own register flow.
calls: func_8004E4C0(int value, unsigned short width, char *buf, int pad) - existing extern declared in src/code.c at func_8004E57C's site
func_8004E478(char *buf, unsigned short width) - reverses `width` bytes at buf in place, returns buf unchanged (v0 == a0 at entry)
